sanskrit:
अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राः
सर्वे सहैवा वनिपालसङ्घैः ।
भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथासौ
सहास्मदीयैरपि योधमुख्यैः ॥ ११-२६॥
iast:
amī ca tvāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāḥ
sarve sahaivā vanipālasaṅghaiḥ
bhīṣmo droṇaḥ sūtaputrastathāsau
sahāsmadīyairapi yodhamukhyaiḥ 11-26
translation: All the sons of Dhritarashtra with hosts of kings of the earth, Bhishma, Drona and the son of a charioteer, Karna, with the warrior chieftains of ours;
